measurementContract.errorPopulation: compiler errors caused by replacing class-name comparison carriers with ClassNameV0 while ClassNameV0 has no PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, or Hash derives
measurementContract.aggregation: count compiler errors per crate and in total
measurementContract.idiomPopulation: non-test Rust source lines that contain both a class-name-labelled binding and a comparison primitive

decisionArms.scopeRule: seal every measured crate with at most 32 compiler errors and cover the remaining crates with the egress and idiom censuses

decisionArms.reentryCondition: a later carrier migration measures at most 320 total compiler errors with at least four crates at or below 32 errors
